label: Workspace Switcher
description: Application shell with a workspace switcher. Best for an inset variant layout whose header dropdown switches the workspace named in the page breadcrumb, beside stat cards and a deploy list.

label: Icon Rail
description: Icon rail that collapses. Best for narrowing the nav to icons while the brand tile and account avatar stay in view, toggled by an edge strip or a header button.

label: Docs Navigation
description: Documentation nav with sub-menus. Best for an always open panel with no toggle where typing opens every section that still matches, with the current page trail open on load.

label: Inspector Panel
description: Right-hand inspector panel. Best for issue details beside the record: assignees with owner and remove actions, linked work, an activity feed and an Open in board button.

label: Filter & Loading
description: Filtering, loading and empty states. Best for a project list whose pinned rows survive any query, with a refresh spinner, a clear button in the search box and a plan usage footer.
